feature_source: app.pipelines.vibration.features.extract_vibration_features (the existing, already-validated vibration signal-processing pipeline) - no new feature engineering was introduced for this model.
input_unit_of_analysis: One IMS file (20,480 samples, 20kHz sample rate, ~1.024s snapshot) = one feature vector. No sub-windowing.
preprocessing: None for the exported model (tree-based, scale-invariant). A StandardScaler is fit and saved alongside the model only for the logistic_regression baseline, which was not selected as best.
caveat: rms and kurtosis are also the exact quantities the training labels were derived from - see models/vibration/model_metadata.json's IMPORTANT_tautology_finding before interpreting feature importance as physical causation.
